'''Wampa Valley''' was a valley on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] that was home to a large number of [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]], including the giant wampa, [[Unkajo/Legends|Unkajo]]. It was linked to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] via a tunnel, which was blocked off by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], but was reopened during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. At the end of the valley, there was an [[Wampa Valley base|abandoned Rebel Base]].

During the Battle of Hoth, the Rebel researcher, [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Blainekie]], traveled to the valley, to study the wampas. He hired some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to help him with killing some of them.
